title: (RHEA-2023:0926) ACS 3.74 enhancement update
portal_summary: Updated images are now available for Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security (RHACS). The updated image includes new features and bug fixes.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes|Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes for IBM Power, little endian|3|ppc64le
Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes|Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes|3|x86_64
Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes|Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security for Kubernetes for IBM Z and LinuxONE|3|s390x
portal_solution: To take advantage of the new features, bug fixes, and enhancements in RHACS 3.74, you are advised to upgrade to RHACS 3.74.0.
portal_description:
Release of RHACS 3.74 provides these changes:

New features:

* Support for IBM Power and IBM Z on secured clusters for OpenShift version 4.10, 4.11, and 4.12
* Clair scanner version 4 support
* Network Graph 2.0 (Technology Preview)
* Updated Global Search in the RHACS portal
* Extra fields for improved syslog integration
* Scale and performance improvements
* Troubleshooting guide provided when Collector kernel module is missing

The following new features are available only for RHACS Cloud Service or if the PostgreSQL database option (Technology Preview) is installed:

* Collections of resources defined using matching patterns that can be used in Vulnerability Management reporting 
* Policy categories can be added and configured in the Policy Management tab

Deprecated and removed features: See the Release Notes.

Notice of upcoming changes:

* RHACS version 3.74 is the last release that supports OpenShift Container Platform versions 4.6, 4.7, 4.8, and 4.9. RHACS version 4.0 will not support these OpenShift Container Platform versions or earlier releases.
* Permissions changes are planned. See the Release Notes for more information.

Bug fixes:

* The RHACS Operator previously incorrectly removed owner references from the stackrox-db Persistent Volume Claim. This could cause an error such as “Failed reconciling PVC "stackrox-db". Please remove the storageClassName and size properties from your spec [...]”. The bug is fixed. However, if you receive this message, you need to perform the steps described in the Knowledgebase article: https://access.redhat.com/solutions/6995414.

* The v1/alerts/summary/counts endpoint, which is used by the Policy violations by severity and Policy violations by category widgets on the Dashboard, was fixed to prevent Central from crashing in highly-scaled environments. (ROX-13829)

* RHACS previously was not able to correctly identify the signature of images that contained the same content but were stored in different registries, causing problems with alerts and enforcement. This issue has been fixed and RHACS will now correctly identify signatures of images from different registries. 

Known issues:

* Currently, RHACS does not support alerts for security policy violations for containers running with default seccomp profiles-Unconfined. The alert violations for Unconfined seccomp profile are generated only if the seccomp profile is explicitly set to "Unconfined" in the container specification. There is no workaround. (ROX-13490)

* In the RHACS portal, the Platform Configuration -> Clusters page does not display information in the Cloud Provider field for Azure Red Hat OpenShift and Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS (ROSA) clusters. There is no workaround. (ROX-14399)
